integrity: Derivation uses the published 2015 facet integral; its normalization, beta tilt, convexity lemma, and sharp endpoints are reconstructed. Numerical diagnostics supplement analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform halfsphere samples, d >= 2 fixed, n >= d+1. No generalization to other laws or simultaneous high-dimensional limits. Unindexed historical inequalities may exist.
title: Sharp finite-sample normalization of halfsphere-polytope facet deficits
